title: Traffic shift game day notes (Hosted API): learnings + doc updates
content:
Traffic shift game day (Hosted API)
Date: 2025-01-22
Facilitator: Evelyn

Scenario
- Simulated us-west GPU capacity crunch + elevated inference 5xx
- Goal: manually shift new traffic to us-east without saturating target

What worked
- Gradual 20% -> 50% -> 80% shift kept 429s manageable
- Explicit handoff between Infra (drain) and Platform (router override) reduced confusion

What was confusing
- People searched for "failover" and missed the Platform runbook because it said "routing override"
- Several folks didn’t know the oncall checklist existed

Action items
- Add "failover" label/tag to Platform page
- Add a short "when to do cluster drain vs regional shift" section to SRE runbook
- Add a reminder: always set override expiry; follow up to remove override

Links (the docs we used)
- SRE manual traffic shift runbook: confluence://eng-sre/manual-traffic-shift-hosted-api-regional-failover
- Platform routing override runbook: confluence://eng-platform/router-policy-manual-traffic-shift
- Infra drain + handoff runbook: confluence://eng-infra/gpu-cluster-drain-and-traffic-shift-handoff
- Oncall checklist: confluence://oncall-and-incident-response/initiating-regional-traffic-shift-checklist

Notes to self
- In the next drill, simulate target region nearing saturation so we practice partial rollback
